#Batch effects

##Building a DESeq2 model for SVA Normalization
```{r}
#DESeq2 is used to create a normalized count matrix,that is used for SVA
dds_null_lab <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = new_filtered_counts_lab,
                              colData = filtered_meta_lab,
                              design = ~ 1) # ~1 models the gene expression without any constraints (this is a "blank" model)

#Estimate factor size and normalize the dds model
dds_null_lab <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_null_lab)

normalized_counts_lab <- counts(dds_null_lab, normalized = TRUE)
```



##Finding unknown batch effects using sva
```{r}
#Create a model that saves variation from Final State, Genotype ID, and Real_timepoint???
mod_lab <- model.matrix(~ Final_State + Genotype_ID, data = filtered_meta_lab) #Adding Real_timepoint.x removes an extra SV and adding Genotype_ID removes an extra 9.

#Create a null model
mod0_lab <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = filtered_meta_lab)

#Remove genes with zero counts
zeroes_removed_counts_lab <- normalized_counts_lab[
  rowSums(normalized_counts_lab) > 0,] #keeps rows in normalized_counts_lab that have more than 0 genes.

#Estimates the value of the surrogate variables. 
sva_matrix_lab <- svaseq(
  zeroes_removed_counts_lab,
  mod = mod_lab,
  mod0 = mod0_lab,
  B = 200)
```



#Check whether SVs is associated with SCTLD_RNA
```{r}
#Loop through all 6 surrogate variables
for (i in 1:6) {

  # Create boxplot comparing each SV to Final_State
  boxplot(sva_matrix_lab$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_lab$Final_State, #compares the first surrogate variable to SCTLD_RNA result
          xlab = "Final State Status",
          ylab = paste("Surrogate Variable", i),
          main = paste("SV", i, "vs Final State Status"))

  #Summarize significance of svs explained by/associated with Final_State
  print(paste("Results for SV", i)) #prints string with the number of the correlated sv next to it
  print(summary(lm(sva_matrix_lab$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_lab$Final_State)))} #lm is a linear regression model to determine significance/association
```

#Identify significant correlations
```{r}
#Create an empty vector to store p-values
sv_pvalues <- numeric(6)

#Loop through all 14 surrogate variables
for (i in 1:6) {

  #Run linear regression
  model <- lm(sva_matrix_lab$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_lab$Final_State) #compares the first surrogate variable to SCTLD_RNA result

  #Extract p-value for SCTLD_RNA
  sv_pvalues[i] <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]}

names(sv_pvalues) <- paste0("SV", 1:5) #name each of the p-values in sv_pvalue_field with the surrogate variable
significant_SVs <- names(sv_pvalues[sv_pvalues < 0.05]) #Identify significant svs
significant_SVs
```

#Add SVs to metadata so it can be incorporated into the dds model
```{r}
meta_sva_lab <- cbind(
  filtered_meta_lab,
  SV = sva_matrix_lab$sv)
```


#Create a full DESeq2 model for vst transformation and limma
```{r}
dds_lab <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = new_filtered_counts_lab,
  colData = meta_sva_lab,
  design = ~ SV.1 + SV.2 + SV.3 + SV.4 + SV.6 + Genotype_ID + Final_State)

dds_lab <- DESeq(dds_lab)

res_lab <- results(
  dds_lab,
  contrast = c("Final_State", "Diseased", "Healthy"))


#Check how many DEGs remain after removing Genotype_ID and SVs
print(res_lab)

sig_lab <- as.data.frame(res_lab)
t <- sig_lab %>% filter(padj<0.1)

print(t)
```




##VST Normalization and SVA Removal with Limma
```{r}
#Normalizing with vst
vsd_lab <- vst(dds_lab, blind = FALSE) #blind = FALSE takes into model consideration

#Extract transformed expression matrix
vst_counts_lab <- assay(vsd_lab)

#Batch correction using limma
design_lab <- model.matrix(
  ~ Final_State,
  data = filtered_meta_lab)

batch_corrected_lab <- removeBatchEffect(
  vst_counts_lab,
  batch = filtered_meta_lab$Genotype_ID, #categorical variable
  covariates = sva_matrix_lab$sv[, c(1:4, 6), drop = FALSE], #numerical vector
  design = design_lab)
```



##Samples - hierarchical clustering
```{r}
#Create clustering trees before and after batch correction
htree_pre_lab  <- hclust(dist(t(vst_counts_lab)), method = "average")
htree_post_lab <- hclust(dist(t(batch_corrected_lab)), method = "average")

#check if sample order and metadata match
stopifnot(all(colnames(vst_counts_lab) == colnames(batch_corrected_lab)))
stopifnot(colnames(vst_counts_lab) == rownames(filtered_meta_lab))


#Pre Batch Correction Lab
range(htree_pre_lab$height)
par(cex = 1.2)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
plot(htree_pre_lab,
     main = "Clustering (Pre Batch Correction lab)",
     sub = "", xlab = "",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.2, cex.main = 1,
     labels = filtered_meta_lab$Final_State)


#Pose Batch Correction Lab
range(htree_post_lab$height)
par(cex = 1.2)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
plot(htree_post_lab,
     main = "Clustering (Post Batch Correction lab)",
     sub = "", xlab = "",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.2, cex.main = 1,
     labels = filtered_meta_lab$Final_State)
```




##PCA of the field data
```{r}
#Run PCA on transposed matrix (samples as rows)
pca_lab <- prcomp(t(batch_corrected_lab), scale. = FALSE)

#Variance explained
percentVar <- round(
  100 * (pca_lab$sdev^2 / sum(pca_lab$sdev^2)))[1:2]

#Build PCA data frame for plotting
pca_df_lab <- as.data.frame(pca_lab$x)
pca_df_lab$sample <- rownames(pca_df_lab)
pca_df_lab$Final_State <- filtered_meta_lab$Final_State[match(pca_df_lab$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_lab))] #pca_df_lab is a matrix that contains pc1 and pc1 coordinates for each sample. I added a sample column that matches Final_State to each of the coordinates. I need to add SCTLD_RNA so it will be color coded properly.

#Plot
ggplot(pca_df_lab, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Final_State)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Healthy" = "lightblue",
    "Diseased" = "darkblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Filtered Lab Counts (After Batch Correction)",
    subtitle = "All filtered genes used (VST, blind = FALSE)",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
```
